title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
title_zh: 语言智能体的协同演化行动与预测

paragraphs.en: Training language agents is bottlenecked by the high cost of long-horizon rollouts, yet standard agentic reinforcement learning (RL) learns only from a terminal scalar reward, leaving the supervision in intermediate steps largely unused. Prior work exploits this supervision through value targets that estimate per-step success probabilities or observation targets that fit environment response. Both are hard to construct well: (1) value targets come from the same single scalar signal for each step in the trajectory, and (2) observation targets, such as web pages and terminal logs, are long and noisy and reach only one step ahead. We propose CoPE , which adds a third kind of multi-step action targets. On successful on-policy trajectories, CoPE trains the policy backbone to generate the action sequences that follows each history. Each action is also supervised when forecast from the preceding histories, forming a temporal ensemble that the shared backbone absorbs during training, and this enables acting and forecasting to co-evolve. The policy still acts one step at a time at inference, with no overhead. Across five benchmarks (ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, and AppWorld), CoPE (1) achieves stronger aggregate performance than GRPO and RL baselines with predictive auxiliary targets across simulated environments, while improving overall performance on both realistic applications; (2) delivers up to 1.9 × 1.9\times and 2.0 × 2.0\times higher sample efficiency than ECHO and GRPO, respectively, on ScienceWorld; and (3) achieves these gains with a single policy backbone, without additional models, separate pretraining, or inference overhead. The codebase is available at https://github.com/ulab-uiuc/CoPE .

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) enable autonomous agents to tackle complex, long-horizon tasks such as web navigation ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , agentic coding ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2023 ; Sapkota et al., 2025 ) , and scientific discovery ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Buehler, 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) . However, training these agents remains computationally expensive. Because each rollout involves numerous interaction steps and tool calls, extracting the maximum learning signal from a limited number of interactions is crucial ( Liu and van der Schaar, 2025 ) . Yet, standard agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often learns only from a single scalar reward at the end of a trajectory, leaving stepwise supervision in the process, such as intermediate actions and environment observations, largely unused.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）使自主智能体能够处理复杂且长期规划的任务，例如网页导航（Zheng 等，2024；Deng 等，2023；Zhang 等，2025）、智能体编程（Yang 等，2024；Hong 等，2023；Sapkota 等，2025）以及科学发现（Zheng 等，2025；Buehler，2024；Lu 等，2024；Yamada 等，2025）。 然而，训练这些智能体在计算上仍然成本高昂。 由于每次展开都涉及大量交互步骤和工具调用，因此从有限的交互中提取最大的学习信号至关重要（Liu 和 van der Schaar，2025）。 但标准的智能体强化学习（RL）通常仅从轨迹末端的单个标量奖励中学习，导致过程中的逐步监督信息（例如中间动作和环境观察结果）基本未被利用。

paragraphs.en: To exploit more intermediate supervision from the process, prior work constructs two kinds of additional targets. Value targets are estimates of how likely each intermediate step is to lead to success, obtained from process reward models ( Choudhury, 2025 ; Xi et al., 2026 ) or step-level credit assignment ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2026 ) , and serve as dense rewards or advantages. Observation targets are the environment’s next observation or state. Some methods fit a separate LLM world model to them and use it to plan or to synthesize additional experience ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) ; others fit them as an auxiliary objective of the policy backbone, before or alongside policy optimization ( Shrivastava et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了从过程中利用更多的中间监督，先前的研究构建了两种类型的额外目标。 价值目标是对于每个中间步骤导致成功的可能性估计，这些估计来自过程奖励模型（Choudhury, 2025；Xi et al., 2026）或步骤级信用分配（Feng et al., 2025；Kong et al., 2026），并用作密集奖励或优势。 观察目标是环境的下一个观察结果或状态。 一些方法会针对这些目标拟合一个独立的 LLM 世界模型，并利用它进行规划或合成额外经验（Chen et al., 2025；Ding et al., 2026）；另一些方法则将其作为策略主干的辅助目标，在策略优化之前或同时拟合（Shrivastava et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026；Yu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Key challenges . Both existing prediction targets are difficult to construct effectively in complex agentic environments. (1) Value targets are derived from only the shared outcome. A trajectory records only its final outcome, not the success probability of each step, so every step is labeled with this same outcome, whose randomness comes mostly from later actions and observations rather than from the step itself. Distinguishing between steps requires step-level annotations, additional rollouts from intermediate states, or exact recurrence of states across rollouts. (2) Observation targets are noisy and reach only one step ahead. In web navigation or agentic coding, most tokens of the next observation (e.g., HTML DOM trees or verbose terminal logs) are irrelevant to the decision (Fig. 1 a), so the prediction loss is dominated by reproducing them. The target also covers only single-step transition; reaching later steps requires chaining predictions, where errors compound.
paragraphs.zh: 关键挑战。 在复杂的智能体环境中，现有的两种预测目标都难以有效构建。 (1) 价值目标仅从共享结果中推导得出。 一条轨迹只记录其最终结果，而非每一步的成功概率，因此每一步都被标记为相同的这一结果，而该结果的随机性主要源于后续的动作和观察，而非步骤本身。 要区分不同步骤，需要步骤级的标注、从中间状态出发的额外展开，或跨展开的状态精确重复。 (2) 观察目标存在噪声，且仅能预测一步之后的情况。 在网络导航或智能体编程中，下一个观察结果的大多数标记（例如 HTML DOM 树或冗长的终端日志）与决策无关（图 1a），因此预测损失主要由重复生成这些标记所主导。 该目标也只涵盖单步转换；要到达后续步骤，则需要将多个预测串联起来，而误差会在此过程中累积。

paragraphs.en: Our solution . We propose CoPE , which constructs a third kind of target: multi-step action targets . Alongside GRPO, CoPE employs multi-step action forecasting on successful on-policy trajectories, predicting actions a t : t + K a_{t:t+K} directly from the current history while skipping the intervening observations. We show that the population optimum of this objective is Pr ( a t : t + K ∣ h t , success ) \Pr(a_{t:t+K}\mid h_{t},\text{success}) , a hindsight distribution ( Harutyunyan et al., 2019 ; Russo, 2026 ) that conditions on both the history and the episode’s eventual success. Success thus enters as a condition that selects trajectories, not as a label assigned to each step. Therefore, CoPE overcomes previous limitations in three key ways. (1) Action targets are specific to each step. A successful trajectory labels each step with its own continuation, the actions that actually followed it. (2) Action targets are decision-relevant. Actions are concise (Fig. 1 a), so the loss is not spent on irrelevant observation content. (3) Multi-step action targets span the horizon and form an implicit temporal ensemble. Each action is supervised both where it is taken and when it is forecast from the K K preceding histories, and the shared backbone absorbs this ensemble into the policy through training alone. This agrees with the delay view of action chunking in robot learning, where predicting chunks trains each action from the current and several earlier observations; the resulting ensemble of delayed predictors, which ACT averages explicitly at test time ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , accounts for much of chunking’s benefit ( Lazzati et al., 2026 ) . CoPE differs by still acting one step at a time at inference, with no overhead .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的解决方案。 我们提出了 CoPE，它构建了一种第三类目标：多步动作目标。 除了 GRPO，CoPE 还在成功的策略内轨迹上采用多步动作预测，直接从当前历史中预测动作 a t : t + K a_{t:t+K}，同时跳过中间的观察结果。 我们证明，该目标函数的群体最优解为 Pr ( a t : t + K ∣ h t , success ) \Pr(a_{t:t+K}\mid h_{t},\text{success})，这是一种事后分布（Harutyunyan 等人，2019；Russo，2026），它以历史信息和整个回合的最终成功作为条件。 因此，成功作为一个筛选轨迹的条件被引入，而不是作为分配给每一步的标签。 因此，CoPE 在三个关键方面克服了先前的局限性。 (1) 动作目标是针对每一步的具体目标。 一条成功的轨迹会用其自身的延续——即实际跟随它的动作——为每一步打上标签。 (2) 动作目标与决策相关。 动作是简洁的（图 1a），因此损失不会浪费在无关的观察内容上。 (3) 多步动作目标跨越了整个时间范围，并形成一个隐式的时间集成模型。 每个动作既在其被执行的时刻受到监督，也在从 K 个先前历史中预测时受到监督，而共享的主干网络仅通过训练就将这种集成模型吸收到了策略中。 这与机器人学习中的动作分块延迟观点一致：在这种观点中，预测分块会从当前及若干更早的观察结果中训练每个动作；由此产生的延迟预测器集成模型（ACT 在测试时明确对其进行了平均（Zhao 等人，2023）），解释了分块优势的很大一部分（Lazzati 等人，2026）。 CoPE 的不同之处在于，它在推理时仍然一步一步地执行动作，且没有额外开销。

paragraphs.en: Main findings . We evaluate CoPE on five benchmarks spanning three simulated environments (ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) , ScienceWorld ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , and WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) ) and two realistic applications ( τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2025 ) and AppWorld ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) ). Our experiments yield three main findings. (1) Broad improvements: CoPE outperforms GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) and observation-prediction baselines (ECHO ( Shrivastava et al., 2026 ) and RWML ( Yu et al., 2026 ) ) on aggregate metrics in the three simulated environments, and improves overall metrics on both realistic applications (despite a negative result on the Airline domain of τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench). (2) Sample efficiency: on ScienceWorld, CoPE is up to 1.9 × 1.9\times and 2.0 × 2.0\times more sample-efficient than ECHO and GRPO, respectively. (3) Low overhead: on ScienceWorld, the action forecasting pass adds just 11 % 11\% time per training step on average, while shorter rollouts reduce the measured end-to-end step time by 9 % 9\% ; CoPE requires neither a separate model nor a pretraining stage.

paragraphs.en: Sample-efficient agentic RL . Methods for sample-efficient agentic RL follow two main directions. The first makes better use of outcome rewards, either by refining credit assignment within trajectories ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Kong et al., 2026 ) or by converting completed interactions into extra policy supervision via hindsight rewriting or on-policy distillation ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) . These methods change how sparse outcomes are assigned or reused, without necessarily introducing a predictive objective. The second learns from the environment feedback available at every step, typically by adding auxiliary prediction of future states or observations to policy training ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Shrivastava et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . Such objectives provide dense token-level supervision but generally focus on a single environment transition. CoPE combines elements of both directions: success filtering reuses outcome rewards, while multi-horizon prediction learns from how trajectories unfold in action space rather than reconstructing observations.

paragraphs.en: Multi-horizon prediction . CoPE is closely related to several forms of multi-horizon and outcome-conditioned prediction. Multi-token prediction trains language models to predict several future tokens ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ) , while robotic policies such as ACT and Diffusion Policy predict sequences of future actions ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Chi et al., 2023 ) . Multi-token prediction is closest architecturally because multiple offsets are learned by one backbone, whereas action chunking is closest in the structure of its targets. Outcome-conditioned sequence modeling conditions policies on desired returns, while self-imitation emphasizes high-return trajectories ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Oh et al., 2018 ) ; both connect policy learning to trajectory-level outcomes. Accordingly, the k = 0 k=0 term in CoPE is success-filtered imitation, while the k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 terms extend this supervision to multiple future action offsets. CoPE uses these predictions as an auxiliary objective during on-policy GRPO: targets are regenerated from successful rollouts, and the predicted future actions are not executed as a chunk but affect acting through the shared backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 多时域预测。 CoPE 与多种形式的多时域预测和结果条件预测密切相关。 多标记预测训练语言模型来预测多个未来标记（Gloeckle 等，2024），而 ACT 和 Diffusion Policy 等机器人策略则预测未来动作序列（Zhao 等，2023；Chi 等，2023）。 从架构上看，多标记预测最为接近，因为多个偏移量由同一个主干网络学习；而从目标结构上看，动作分块最为接近。 结果条件序列建模将策略与期望回报关联起来，而自我模仿则强调高回报轨迹（Chen 等，2021；Oh 等，2018）；两者都将策略学习与轨迹级别的结果联系起来。 因此，CoPE 中 k = 0 的项是成功过滤的模仿，而 k ≥ 1 的项则将这种监督扩展到多个未来动作偏移量。 CoPE 在在线策略 GRPO 期间将这些预测用作辅助目标：目标从成功的执行中重新生成，且预测的未来动作不会作为一个分块执行，而是通过共享的主干网络影响实际动作。

paragraphs.en: Tasks . We evaluate on five long-horizon agent benchmarks with sparse rewards that differ in observation complexity, action space, and horizon. Three are simulated environments: (1) ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) for household tasks, (2) ScienceWorld ( Wang et al., 2022 ) for elementary science experiments, and (3) WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) for online shopping over long web-page observations. Two are realistic applications: (1) τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2025 ) for policy-constrained customer service with a user simulator, and (2) AppWorld ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) for composing API calls across consumer apps with code as actions. We use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2024 ) for the three simulated environments and τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct for the more difficult AppWorld tasks. Details are available in Appendix A . Unless otherwise stated, all analysis experiments are carried out on ScienceWorld.

paragraphs.en: Baselines . On the simulated environments (Table 3 ), we compare against three groups. ( 1 ) Prompting : Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) , GPT-5-mini and GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026 ) , and Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , which adds verbal self-reflection on failed trials. ( 2 ) RL w/o auxiliary loss : RFT ( Yuan et al., 2023 ) , rejection sampling fine-tuning; GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , critic-free RL with group-normalized advantages; and EMPG ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , which rescales GRPO’s step-level gradients by policy entropy. ( 3 ) RL w/ auxiliary loss : RWML ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , which first trains next-state prediction on environment transitions and then runs GRPO; and ECHO ( Shrivastava et al., 2026 ) , which adds a next-observation prediction loss to GRPO. Both supervise only single-step transitions, testing whether forecasting actions over multiple steps is more effective than predicting the next observation. paragraphs.en: Q1: What is the empirical evidence for acting and forecasting co-evolution?
paragraphs.zh: 问题1：关于行动与预测的协同进化，有哪些经验证据？

paragraphs.en: In Sec. 5.3 , we analyze the co-evolution mechanism between acting and forecasting. The acting-to-forecasting direction is straightforward: the policy collects successful trajectories as the forecast targets. Conversely, for the forecasting-to-acting direction, our analysis suggests that forecasting improves action selection through implicit ensembling via shared parameters. Here, we provide empirical evidence to support this claim.

(2026) traces the benefits of action chunking in robot imitation learning ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) to delayed prediction: a prediction of a t a_{t} has a delay k k if made without the last k k observations. paragraphs.en: Q3: Why must action forecasting loss be conditioned on success, and what does it learn?
paragraphs.zh: 问题3：为什么动作预测损失必须以成功为条件，它又学习了什么？

paragraphs.en: Fundamentally, the action forecasting loss must align with the primary RL objective. Without success conditioning, the model is forced to imitate average or failed trajectories, creating a severe objective conflict and leading to zero reward after the first few steps of training. With it, the forecaster learns how the agent behaves in episodes that eventually succeed. Because this conditions on the whole episode rather than on the agent’s choices alone, the targets for similar-looking histories come mostly from the tasks in which success is easiest, a known limitation of outcome-conditioned imitation ( Paster et al., 2022 ; Eysenbach et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 从根本上说，动作预测损失必须与强化学习的主要目标保持一致。 如果没有成功条件约束，模型将被迫模仿平均或失败的轨迹，从而产生严重的目标冲突，并导致在训练最初几步之后奖励归零。 有了这种条件约束，预测器就能学会智能体在最终成功的回合中的行为方式。 由于这种条件约束基于整个回合而非仅基于智能体的选择，因此对于看似相似的历史记录，其目标大多来自那些最容易成功的任务，这是结果条件模仿法的一个已知局限性（Paster 等人，2022；Eysenbach 等人，2022）。

paragraphs.en: As discussed in Sec. 5 , the number of successful rollouts within a group naturally increases as the policy improves. Without normalization, the accumulated forecasting gradient scales directly with this success count. This shifting balance between the primary RL objective and the forecasting auxiliary loss causes spikes in gradient norms and reward fluctuations. Averaging over successful rollouts removes this direct dependence, although the resulting loss can still vary with trajectory length. As shown in Fig. 8 , normalization reduces these spikes.

paragraphs.en: We introduced CoPE , which trains a language agent to forecast its own future actions alongside acting. Rather than fitting noisy observations, CoPE trains on the success-filtered action chunk a t : t + K a_{t:t+K} , combining the current-action target with forecasts up to K K steps in the future. Across five benchmarks, CoPE improves aggregate results over RL baselines. It also improves sample efficiency with little computational overhead. We hope this work motivates further methods for sample-efficient long-horizon agentic RL.

paragraphs.en: This work introduces CoPE , a training algorithm for improving the sample efficiency of reinforcement learning for LLM-based agents; it is a methodological contribution rather than a deployed system, and its societal impact is largely mediated by how downstream practitioners apply it. All experiments are conducted on standard agentic benchmarks (ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, and AppWorld) using open-weight or proprietary models strictly for research evaluation; the work does not involve human subjects, crowdsourcing, or the collection of new personal data. By coupling action forecasting and policy optimization within a single backbone, CoPE can reduce environment-interaction costs without training or serving a separate world model, lowering the barrier for resource-constrained groups to study long-horizon LLM agents. We also note that, like other advances in sample-efficient agentic RL, more capable autonomous agents could in principle be misused for tasks such as automated misinformation or unauthorized web automation; practitioners building on CoPE in higher-stakes domains should pair it with appropriate safety evaluation, deployment-time monitoring, and human oversight.

paragraphs.en: τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench ships its own train/test partition per domain, and we use all three domains together: retail ( 74 74 train, 40 40 test), airline ( 30 30 , 20 20 ) and telecom ( 74 74 , 40 40 ), i.e. 178 178 training and 100 100 test tasks. We first compute the metric separately for each domain and report their unweighted arithmetic mean, so retail, airline, and telecom contribute equally despite their different test-set sizes. The environment server is launched with TAU2_DOMAIN=retail+airline+telecom and the split selected by TAU2_TASK_SPLIT ; task ids are positional across the concatenated domains in that order, and the id files are generated from the same loaders the server uses ( scripts/make_tau2_itemid.py ), so a row cannot name one task and train on another. Each task pairs a customer goal with a database state and a set of state-based assertions, and every episode also runs a simulated customer implemented with GPT-4o-mini at temperature 0.7 0.7 . paragraphs.en: AppWorld ships four splits and we use its own partition unchanged, read with appworld.load_task_ids : train ( 90 90 tasks), dev ( 57 57 ), test_normal ( 168 168 ) and test_challenge ( 417 417 ), 732 732 in total. We train on train and evaluate on both test splits, which the evaluation harness runs as separate passes because the environment servers have to be restarted per split ( APPWORLD_SPLIT selects the task list). test_challenge is not a harder sample of the same distribution: it is built from scenarios held out entirely, so it measures transfer to unseen app combinations rather than to unseen instances of seen ones. An AppWorld task is a Python REPL session against nine simulated apps and is scored by state-based unit tests, so success is all-or-nothing per task; with 90 90 training tasks it is by far the smallest training pool of the five environments.
paragraphs.zh: AppWorld 提供了四个分割集，我们直接使用其自身的分区不变，通过 appworld.load_task_ids 读取：训练集（90 个任务）、开发集（57 个）、常规测试集（168 个）和挑战测试集（417 个），总计 732 个任务。 我们在训练集上进行训练，并在两个测试分割集上进行评估；评估框架会分别运行这两个测试集，因为每个分割集都需要重启环境服务器（APPWORLD_SPLIT 用于选择任务列表）。test_challenge 并非来自同一分布的更难样本，而是由完全保留的场景构建而成，因此它衡量的是模型向未见过的应用组合的迁移能力，而非向已知应用的未见实例的迁移能力。 AppWorld 的一个任务是一个针对九个模拟应用的 Python REPL 会话，并通过基于状态的单元测试进行评分，因此每个任务的成败是全或无的；由于训练集包含 90 个任务，它成为五个环境中规模最小的训练池。

paragraphs.en: We compare our method with prompting and training baselines spanning verbal self-reflection, rejection-sampling fine-tuning, online reinforcement learning, and observation-space predictive supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的方法与多种提示与训练基线方法进行了比较，这些方法涵盖了语言自我反思、拒绝采样微调、在线强化学习以及观察空间预测监督。

paragraphs.en: Reflexion is a prompting baseline that asks the agent to verbally reflect on a failed trial and uses the resulting reflection to guide a subsequent attempt, without updating model parameters. We apply Reflexion to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld.
paragraphs.zh: Reflexion 是一种提示基线方法，它要求智能体对失败的尝试进行口头反思，并利用由此产生的反思来指导后续尝试，而无需更新模型参数。 我们将 Reflexion 应用于 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SciWorld 数据集上的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。

sents.en: Reflexion is a prompting baseline that asks the agent to verbally reflect on a failed trial and uses the resulting reflection to guide a subsequent attempt, without updating model parameters.
sents.zh: Reflexion 是一种提示基线方法，它要求智能体对失败的尝试进行口头反思，并利用由此产生的反思来指导后续尝试，而无需更新模型参数。

sents.en: We apply Reflexion to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld.
sents.zh: 我们将 Reflexion 应用于 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SciWorld 数据集上的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。

paragraphs.en: Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) samples trajectories, retains those that succeed, and fine-tunes the policy by maximum likelihood on their action tokens. Unlike GRPO, it treats the retained trajectories as supervised targets rather than optimizing a group-relative policy-gradient objective. We evaluate RFT on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld.
paragraphs.zh: 拒绝采样微调（RFT）会采样轨迹，保留成功的轨迹，并通过最大似然法对其动作标记进行策略微调。 与 GRPO 不同，它将保留的轨迹视为监督目标，而不是优化一个群体相对的策略梯度目标。 我们在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SciWorld 上对 RFT 进行了评估。

sents.zh: 拒绝采样微调（RFT）会采样轨迹，保留成功的轨迹，并通过最大似然法对其动作标记进行策略微调。

sents.en: We evaluate RFT on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld.
sents.zh: 我们在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SciWorld 上对 RFT 进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: GRPO is an online reinforcement learning baseline. For each training query, the actor samples a group of trajectories from the current policy and optimizes the policy using group-relative advantages. Different from critic-based PPO, GRPO estimates advantages within each sampled group and therefore avoids training an additional value model. In our experiments, GRPO is applied to ALFWorld, WebShop, SciWorld, τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench, and AppWorld.
paragraphs.zh: GRPO 是一种在线强化学习基线方法。 对于每次训练查询，智能体从当前策略中采样一组轨迹，并利用组内相对优势来优化策略。 与基于评论家的 PPO 不同，GRPO 在每个采样组内部估计优势值，因此无需训练额外的价值模型。 在我们的实验中，GRPO 被应用于 ALFWorld、WebShop、SciWorld、τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench 和 AppWorld。

paragraphs.en: The published AppWorld RL baseline numbers reported by G2PO use only difficulty-1/2 tasks: 72 72 training tasks and 105 105 tasks from test_normal , whereas we train on all 90 90 tasks and evaluate the complete test_normal ( 168 168 ) and test_challenge ( 417 417 ) splits. The reported setup also randomly samples its validation pool and differs from ours in prompt, history, and output formats, generation limits ( 512 512 versus 1,024 1{,}024 tokens per turn), and training length ( 50 50 versus 100 100 steps). These published numbers are therefore not controlled comparisons; nevertheless, both GRPO (ours) and CoPE achieve higher normal-split success rates despite our broader evaluation set.
paragraphs.zh: G2PO 公布的 AppWorld RL 基线数据仅使用了难度为 1/2 的任务：72 个训练任务和来自 test_normal 的 105 个任务，而我们的训练则涵盖了全部 90 个任务，并对完整的 test_normal（168 个）和 test_challenge（417 个）数据集进行了评估。 该报告中的设置还从验证池中随机采样，并且在提示、历史信息和输出格式、生成限制（每次对话 512 个词元对比 1,024 个词元）以及训练长度（50 步对比 100 步）方面与我们的设置不同。 因此，这些已公布的数据并非受控比较；尽管如此，尽管我们的评估集更广泛，GRPO（我们的方法）和 CoPE 都取得了更高的正常数据集成功率。

paragraphs.en: RWML is a two-stage world-model-based baseline. In the first stage, the backbone is trained on pre-collected ( h t , a t , o t + 1 ) (h_{t},a_{t},o_{t+1}) triplets to predict the next state, using rewards derived from matching the predicted and actual states. In the second stage, the resulting model is optimized with standard online GRPO on the task reward. Unlike ECHO and CoPE , its world-model objective is applied only before policy optimization rather than alongside it.
paragraphs.zh: RWML 是一种基于世界模型的两阶段基线方法。 在第一阶段，主干网络在预先收集的 ( h t , a t , o t + 1 ) (h_{t},a_{t},o_{t+1}) 三元组上进行训练，以预测下一个状态，并使用通过匹配预测状态与实际状态所获得的奖励进行训练。 在第二阶段，所得模型通过标准在线 GRPO 方法针对任务奖励进行优化。 与 ECHO 和 CoPE 不同，其世界模型目标仅在策略优化之前应用，而非与之并行应用。

sents.zh: RWML 是一种基于世界模型的两阶段基线方法。

sents.zh: 在第二阶段，所得模型通过标准在线 GRPO 方法针对任务奖励进行优化。

paragraphs.en: ECHO is a world-model-augmented reinforcement learning baseline that combines the GRPO loss on action tokens with an auxiliary cross-entropy loss on environment-observation tokens. It reuses the same rollouts, model backbone, and forward-pass logits as policy optimization, thereby providing dense predictive supervision without additional environment interactions or a separately pretrained world model. Unlike RWML, which learns its world model from offline trajectory data before policy optimization, ECHO couples observation-space world modeling directly with online policy updates. We use the same GRPO hyperparameters for ECHO and set the environment-prediction coefficient to 0.01 0.01 on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld.
paragraphs.zh: ECHO 是一种融合了世界模型增强的强化学习基线方法，它将动作标记上的 GRPO 损失与环境观察标记上的辅助交叉熵损失相结合。 它复用了策略优化中的相同 rollout、模型主干和前向传播 logits，从而无需额外的环境交互或单独预训练的世界模型即可提供密集预测监督。 与 RWML 不同，后者在策略优化之前会从离线轨迹数据中学习其世界模型，而 ECHO 则将观察空间的世界建模直接与在线策略更新耦合。 我们对 ECHO 使用了相同的 GRPO 超参数，并在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SciWorld 上将环境预测系数设为 0.01 0.01。

paragraphs.en: EMPG is an entropy-modulated policy gradient baseline that re-calibrates the learning signal based on step-wise predictive uncertainty. Unlike standard policy gradients, where update magnitude is implicitly coupled with action entropy, EMPG amplifies updates for confident correct actions, penalizes confident errors, and attenuates updates from uncertain steps. An additional future-clarity bonus encourages the agent toward lower-entropy next states. In our experiments, we apply EMPG on top of GRPO and evaluate it on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld.

paragraphs.en: Action Forecasting constructs each τ 2 \tau^{2} target directly from an assistant reply.
